title: Registry Lookup (batch output)
description: 02_registry_lookup's output, written by scripts/registry_lookup.py. Exact concept_id match against the canonical registries — no fuzzy matching.

canonical_status.description: new: this path builds the concept's canonical evidence. reuse_registry: an earlier batch already built it — copy it. shared_in_batch: another path in this same batch builds it — wait for and reuse that path's version.

reusable_segment_ids.description: Approved segments already in the video bank for this concept_id. Still re-judged for this path's prerequisites before reuse (playbook §25).
